home.title: AgroPurity
home.tagline: Preliminary browser-based visual grain screening. Capture or upload a photo of grains on white paper, run local analysis, and keep an on-device record.
home.step1: Select wheat and spread grains in a thin layer on plain white A4 paper.
home.step2: Capture with the camera or upload a clear photo under even lighting.
home.step3: The app runs grayscale, Otsu thresholding, region labelling, and provisional classification.
home.step4: Review annotated results, adjust labels if needed, and save a local record.
home.wheat: Wheat — primary prototype target with provisional heuristics.
home.otherGrains: Rice, pulses, and other crops — unavailable until separately calibrated.
home.overlap: Overlapping or touching grains may be counted as one object.
home.notOfficial: Not an official grade, AGMARK certificate, or procurement calculation.
home.onDevice: All analysis runs on-device; images are not uploaded by default.
home.privacyBody: Images and records stay in this browser IndexedDB. No account required. After PWA install, core features can work offline once cached.
home.photoHelpTitle: How to take a good photo
home.photoHelp1: Use plain white paper and spread grains so they do not touch.
home.photoHelp2: Use even light. Avoid strong shadows and shiny glare.
home.photoHelp3: Hold the camera steady and keep grains in focus.
home.photoHelp4: Fill most of the frame with the sample.
disclaimer: Preliminary visual screening aid only. Not an official grade, AGMARK certification, or legal determination. Results are heuristic and may contain errors. Always verify with authorised methods.
